title: Braiding compatibility of additive monoidal functors on homotopy categories
statement: Let C and D be preadditive braided monoidal categories with zero objects and the coproduct and good-tensor hypotheses needed for the monoidal categories of cochain complexes and their homotopy categories. Let G:C→D be additive and strong monoidal, preserving the coproducts defining the complex tensor. Suppose G maps each braiding followed by its oplax tensor comparison to its oplax comparison followed by the target braiding. Then its oplax tensor comparisons on cochain complexes and on homotopy categories obey the same identity for the Koszul braidings. This is the existing proved source-library API, used directly without changing either declaration type.

source.place: Existing proved generic complex and homotopy braiding comparisons, used directly without relocation.

proof.text: For complexes K and L, compare both maps on the summand K^p tensor L^q in degree n. The Koszul braiding contributes (-1)^(pq) on both sides, which G preserves by additivity. The assumed ordinary braiding identity then proves equality of every component.

Choose cochain representatives of both homotopy objects using quotient_obj_surjective. Apply the homotopy quotient functor to the complex equality and use its map_comp and the defining mapHomotopyCategoryδNatTrans component formulas.

lemma mapHomotopyCategory_map_braiding_hom_δ
    (hG : ∀ X Y : C, G.map (β_ X Y).hom ≫ δ G Y X = δ G X Y ≫ (β_ (G.obj X) (G.obj Y)).hom)
    (K L : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ)) :
    (G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map (β_ K L).hom ≫ δ (G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)) L K =
      δ (G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)) K L ≫
        (β_ ((G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)
          ((G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj L)).hom
